## Description

The root of the only healthy hierarchy in the corpus. Every other store with a
`parent` set is deliberately broken: `parent-missing` points at a ticket that
does not exist, and `parent-cycle` points in a loop. Neither can show what a
correct hierarchy looks like, which is what a `parent` filter has to read.

This ticket has two direct children and one grandchild through the first of
them, so a filter that walks the hierarchy instead of matching direct children
gives a different answer and the test can tell them apart.
